# Answers obtained from BigQuery with tools/bqanswers.
# Despite the error's "less than 1000000", BigQuery accepts 1000000 itself.
SELECT S2_COVERINGCELLIDS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), max_cells => 999999)
=> [{"v":"1153886977999746825"}]

SELECT S2_COVERINGCELLIDS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), max_cells => 1000000)
=> [{"v":"1153886977999746825"}]

SELECT S2_COVERINGCELLIDS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), max_cells => 1000001)
=> error: S2_CoveringCellIDs: GetS2CellCovering failed: max_cells should be less than 1000000; error in S2_COVERINGCELLIDS expression

SELECT S2_COVERINGCELLIDS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'), max_level => 3, max_cells => 2147483648)
=> error: S2_CoveringCellIDs: GetS2CellCovering failed: max_cells should be less than 1000000; error in S2_COVERINGCELLIDS expression

SELECT S2_COVERINGCELLIDS(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), max_level => 3, max_cells => 9223372036854775807, buffer => 1000)
=> error: S2_CoveringCellIDs: GetS2CellCovering failed: max_cells should be less than 1000000; error in S2_COVERINGCELLIDS expression
